name: migrations-append-only
command:
set -e
violated=0
for f in "$COMPASS_GUARD_HEAD_DIR"/cmd/watch/store/migrations/*.sql; do
  [ -e "$f" ] || continue
  base=$(basename "$f")
  staged="$COMPASS_GUARD_STAGED_DIR/cmd/watch/store/migrations/$base"
  if [ ! -f "$staged" ]; then
    echo "$base removed" >&2
    violated=1
  elif ! cmp -s "$f" "$staged"; then
    echo "$base modified" >&2
    violated=1
  fi
done
[ "$violated" -eq 0 ]
failure_message: Migrations are append-only. Never edit or remove a committed migration file — add a new numbered migration instead.
